verdict.rationale: Canny's own docs describe a hosted feedback site that you link from your application, where customers leave feedback directly on your Portal. An embeddable widget is also documented. Voting on ideas and the portal's public visibility are never explicitly evidenced in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of customer voting on ideas, detail on public portal/board configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can host a public feedback portal where customers submit and vote on ideas

citations.quote: In your application, add a link to your Canny feedback site. Put the link somewhere it's easy to find.
or directly from customers on your Portal
when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application
